description:
Record a cross-currency wire transfer between two cash accounts in Portfolio Performance. A portfolio file with a EUR account ('Sparkasse Giro') and a USD account ('Interactive Brokers') is open.

Record a transfer with the following details:
- Source: 'Sparkasse Giro' (EUR)
- Target: 'Interactive Brokers' (USD)
- Date: October 15, 2024
- Amount sent: 2,500.00 EUR
- Amount received: 2,725.00 USD

Ensure the transactions are linked as a single Transfer event (not separate Deposit/Withdrawal entries) so the exchange rate is calculated correctly. Save the portfolio file when finished.
